column1: # Example vqperf configuration matrix. One row per benchmark cell; every
# column maps onto a `vllm serve` or `vllm bench serve` flag. Lines starting
# with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Columns prefixed with 'x_' are
# passed through to the report as labels and never reach a command line.
# profile_* columns require --mode pyt: profiling is a no-op in AoT mode
# parse time rather than producing empty traces an hour later.
